title: FND Doesn't Define Me – My Life, My Rules! | USA Youth Edition
author: Paul Edwards & Jennifer Kerr
description:
🎙️ FND Doesn't Define Me – My Life, My Rules! | USA Youth Edition

 

Your diagnosis is part of your story. It doesn't define who you are!


Welcome to a special youth-focused podcast created by UK-based FND advocates Paul Edwards from the West Midlands, England, and Jennifer Kerr from Scotland, as part of their continued international Functional Neurological Disorder (FND) awareness work.


Created especially for children, teenagers and young adults across the United States, this podcast delivers a powerful message of hope, friendship, individuality and empowerment. Living with FND can bring challenges, but it should never mean that a young person is defined solely by their medical condition.


From elementary school to college, friendships to gaming, music to sports, and hobbies to future ambitions, we explore why every young person deserves opportunities to enjoy life, feel included and pursue their dreams. We don't pretend that living with FND is always easy. Instead, we encourage understanding, compassion, appropriate support and opportunities for young people to enjoy life at their own pace.


🌎 Two UK advocates. One international mission.


Together, Paul Edwards and Jennifer Kerr are working to raise awareness, challenge misconceptions and create accessible, positive resources for the younger FND community. Whether you're living with FND, supporting someone who is, or simply wanting to understand more, you're welcome here.


✨ Be yourself. Have fun. Keep dreaming.

Because FND may be part of your story, but it will NEVER be your whole story!


Created and presented by Paul Edwards & Jennifer Kerr.

Produced specifically for children, teens and young adults in the United States.

🌎 FND HAS NO BORDERS!


Educational and awareness content only. This podcast does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

description:

title: Unicode Character Mapping - Fontgenly
author: Fontgenly
description:
In this episode, we explore how modern client-side web tools perform real-time character transformation from standard ASCII (U+0021–U+007E) to Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols (U+1D400–U+1D7FF). 
By leveraging browser-level JavaScript execution and character code offsets, utilities can render Mathematical Bold, Script, Italic, and Monospace styles without external web fonts, custom CSS, or server-side latency.
Try the zero-dependency live utility:
font changer
Key Topics Covered:
- Standard ASCII vs. Unicode Supplementary Multilingual Plane
- Mathematical Alphanumeric Symbols range (U+1D400–U+1D7FF)
- Eliminating layout shift and font download overhead
- Generating copy-pasteable typography for social media bios

title: The Bambi Trap
author: Rhys Waters
description:
Somewhere in the depths of the internet, a secretive collection of audio files promises something extraordinary: the ability to rewrite who you are. They call it Bambi Sleep.


For some, it's fantasy. For others, an escape. But for those who venture deeper, the lines between pleasure, identity and control can begin to disappear. Who created these mys

terious recordings? What happens to the people who surrender themselves to them? And why do some claim they can never truly escape?


In this five-part investigative documentary, Host Rhys Waters follows a trail of anonymous creators, devoted listeners, disturbing testimonies and extraordinary claims into a world where reality and suggestion become difficult to separate. What begins as an investigation into an obscure internet phenomenon soon raises unsettling questions about consent, manipulation and the power of the human mind.

Is Bambi Sleep an elaborate fantasy, a dangerous experiment in psychological control, or something we don't yet have the language to understand?


There's only one way to find out. Put on your headphones. And listen.

Every episode, Hazel picks something from history she’s curious about. Her dad, Caleb, does the research and tells her a fascinating true story. Hazel hears it for the first time during recording, so her questions, surprises, and unexpected detours are completely unscripted.
From bizarre events and forgotten places to remarkable people and unlikely discoveries, Derailable explores the strange, surprising, and sometimes unbelievable stories hiding in our past.
A history podcast for curious kids and grown-ups alike.

title: La Otra Cara de la Moneda
author: ALEX ARISTA
description: Mercados, Economía y Sociedad.  Un espacio para cuestionar las narrativas, entender el contexto y hacer mejores preguntas para tomar mejores decisiones.

title: Gen-XZ
author: feat. Kim + Rae
description: Gen-XZ takes a mother and child's conversations into the public square, unfiltered and full of personality. Different generations, lived experiences, and now continents. The kitchen table may be time zones away, but the conversation never stops. We won't always agree (and that's half the fun), but the goal isn't to win – it's to listen, understand, and grow with curiosity and respect. Come laugh, disagree, and join the conversation!   – Launching Oct. 20

title: List It
author: Sinead Hegarty
description:
LIST IT is the podcast where two girls, two new mums and two best friends sit down with a list of everything they need to talk about.

From relationships and friendships to motherhood, pop culture, embarrassing stories, unpopular opinions and the things you’d normally only say in the group chat, nothing is off the list.

Girly, funny, unfiltered and relatable. Come for the list, stay for the chaos.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Picture Lock Podcast
author: Jon Skinner & Zach Beck
description:
Ever wanted to keep score on your movie predictions?
Picture Lock Podcast is two indie filmmakers who think they know movies — and put fake money on it every week, before anyone has seen the picture.
Hear the card. Go to the theater. Next episode, they settle up.
Imaginary dollars. No real bets. Not a sportsbook.

title: Burning The Veil With Ron
author: Ron Cruz
description: Removing the masks we wear, asking difficult questions, and pursuing an authentic life through honest conversations, personal stories, and meaningful growth.

title: PayRise With Clare Ferguson and Simon Rutten
author: Verve Partners Production
description:
What if the real question is not “Should I ask for a pay rise?” but “Am I being valued in the way that actually matters?”
Payrise is the career and workplace podcast for Australian professionals navigating growth, leadership, salary, and self worth.
Hosted by Clare Ferguson and Simon Rutten of Verve Partners, we unpack the quiet questions people ask behind closed doors about loyalty, negotiation, promotions, and when it might be time to move on.
This is Payrise.

title: Permaculture Solutions: Design for Life | The Masterclass Series
author: Graeme Farrer
description: Master the core principles of Permaculture with Graeme Farrer. Based on decades of experience and ongoing study with industry leaders, we break down one principle every week. Discover how to apply ethical design to your land, your business, and your life. It’s time for solutions that work with nature, not against it.

title: The Day in the Life of A & K
author: Alan Cousin and Katherine Allen
description:
The Day in the Life of A & K is a fun, heartfelt Get Up Radio podcast featuring Alan Cousin and Katherine Allen as they share the real ups, downs, laughs, challenges, careers, relationships, and everyday moments that shape their life together.

From entrepreneurship and media to Katherine’s nursing journey, love, family, travel, and unexpected adventures, A & K offer honest conversations with humor, personality, and plenty of heart.

It’s a podcast about life, love, ambition, resilience, and learning how to grow together through it all.

title: 1.1 The Crazy Kids Beer
author: Geoffrey
description: Hello everyone I'm geoffrey welcome back to the Crazy Kids Beer today topic is how is beer bad for kids.

title: Pretty Suspicious
author: Pretty Suspicious
description: Pretty Suspicious is a true crime podcast with a mother-daughter duo who love a good mystery, a little makeup, and plenty of girl talk. From chilling cases in Mississippi to shocking crimes around the world, they dive into the stories, theories, and twists that keep us all guessing. Expect true crime, beauty, laughs, and a little bit of everything in between. Because some things are just... Pretty Suspicious.

title: The Direction Podcast
author: Steven Korn and Ryan Henry
description: A wrestling podcast speaking about the direction of sports entertainment; WWE, AEW, TNA and more.

title: Christ Covenant Church
author: Brian J. Orr
description: Teachings and Sermons from Pastor Brian J. Orr of Christ Covenant Church in Apple Valley, California.

title: Watching EastEnders from the Very Beginning The OG
author: watchingeastenders69
description: Comedians Kathryn Mather @beforenowafterthen and Spring "Kathryn" Day @springkathryndayukcomedian  are watching Eastenders from the very beginning to see how far fictional London has come over the past 40 years and marvel  how far it hasn't…watch them give you the highlights and gossip about the lowlifes of Albert Square in good old Watford…it's stupid and it's fun.

title: The Xennial Man
author: thexennialmanpod
description:
Grew up on analog, living in digital, and juggling everything in between? Welcome home.
Remember when we used to spend entire days conversing exclusively in Simpsons quotes? Or feeling like the coffee table felt naked without the latest copy of EW? Keep up with us as we bring our 90s kids perspectives to pop culture and sports.
Multiple days a week, we deliver a sharp, 15-to-20-minute magazine-style show tailored for Xennial men with a dose of ”Financial Zen” to keep your money mindset grounded despite crazy news cycles.
Think of it like your old coffee table reads: quick, and insightful, but now built for your schedule.
Hit follow and start your day informed.

title: The Collision Point
author: Ashley Sterken | Fractional COO For Mom Founders
description:
Welcome to The Collision Point — the podcast about ambition and motherhood, and what happens when the two collide.

Your host, Ashley, is a former corporate COO turned two-time founder, and she’s living this collision right alongside you.

For years, Ashley built her career using the only playbook she knew: work harder, produce more, push through, and keep going until it works. And for a long time, it did. Until she became a mother and suddenly, the playbook that had built her success stopped working overnight.

She didn’t have the language for it then. She called it burnout. She pushed harder. Until eventually, her body made the decision for her.

Now, Ashley sees the collision differently.

Because ambition doesn’t disappear when you become a mother. But the way you pursue it might have to change.

The Collision Point is a space for the judgment, the burnout, the identity shifts, the days that fall apart despite your perfectly planned schedule, and the uncomfortable moments when the life you’re building no longer fits the way you’ve been building it.

Because collisions don’t get solved once and disappear. But they can become fewer, less costly, and less invisible when you stop trying to operate exactly like you did before.

This is about building careers, businesses, and lives that make room for your real life to happen, not ones that break every time it does.

If you’re ambitious, you’re a mother, or you’re somewhere in the collision between the two, you’re in the right place.

title: The Faraway Places
author: Max Hills
description: Welcome to The Faraway Places, a travel podcast that takes you beyond familiar streets and popular tourist destinations to discover the extraordinary world around us. From peaceful coastal villages and remote mountain communities to vibrant cities, ancient landmarks, and breathtaking natural landscapes, every episode brings a new destination to life. We explore local traditions, regional food, fascinating histories, and the people who give each place its unique character. Whether you dream of travelling across continents, discovering hidden corners of the world, or simply learning about places you have never visited, this podcast offers a fresh perspective on travel and discovery. Pack your curiosity and join us on a journey where every destination has a story, every culture offers something new, and the world always has another place waiting to be explored.

title: UNIFY USA Podcast
author: UNIFY USA
description:
This is the official UNIFY USA podcast. UNIFY is a movement bringing Americans together through flag runs, events and a community that shows up for each other in cities all over the country.
On the show we answer your questions straight up and sit down with people who are living the American dream, from entrepreneurs to people making a difference in their own town. Plus whatever else is going on with UNIFY that week.
New episodes every Sunday.

title: San Fernando Valley Property Journal
author: sfvpropertyjournal
description: Property maintenance and infrastructure across the San Fernando Valley. Septic systems, drainage, and the upkeep that keeps a property running.

title: Nephilim Death Squad (Clean)
author: TopLobsta Productions
description: Family-friendly clean edit. Nephilim, fallen angels, demons and the end of days, taken straight from the Bible and delivered by two guys who probably shouldn't have microphones.

title: Loose Boots
author: Will Zwar
description: Take a dive into the stories which are the heart and soul of Australian Rules Football in the Northern Territory

title: The Thinking Mind
author: Nora
description: Welcome to The Thinking Mind, a philosophy podcast that explores the questions behind the way we live, think, and understand the world. What makes a life meaningful? Can we ever know the complete truth? Are our choices truly our own, or are they shaped by the world around us? Each episode takes a closer look at ideas about human nature, happiness, freedom, morality, identity, and the meaning of existence. By connecting philosophical concepts with everyday experiences, this podcast encourages listeners to question assumptions, consider different viewpoints, and develop a deeper understanding of themselves and others. You do not need to be a philosophy expert to join the conversation. All you need is curiosity and a willingness to think beyond the obvious. Tune in to The Thinking Mind, where big questions lead to deeper conversations and every new perspective opens the door to another idea.

title: Higher Ed Today
author: Anna Esaki-Smith and Eddie West
description:
Higher Ed Today is a podcast hosted by Anna Esaki-Smith and Eddie West, exploring the biggest stories shaping higher education in the U.S. and around the world. Each episode features the hosts' analysis of the latest news and trends, with university leaders, policymakers and other experts joining the conversation when their insights can deepen the discussion.
Listeners will get thoughtful analysis, insider perspectives, and smart conversations that cut through the headlines to explain what today's developments mean for students, families, universities, and the future of higher education.

title: Docs Tracey and Paul Discuss It All!
author: TMBO ENTERPRISES
description: Psychiatry, Education, Insight. Docs Tracey and Paul Discuss it All! Two psychiatrists — Dr. Paul E. Keck Jr., MD and Dr. Tracey Goodman Skale, MD of TMBO (Two Minds, Better than One) — illuminate mental illness, teach signs and symptoms, dispel myths, and advocate timely care and dignity. Nearly 70 years of combined expertise. DISCLAIMER: educational/general discussion only, not personalized medical advice; in crisis call the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.

title: Good Read Only
author: Hosted by Sayli Shah
description:
Welcome to Good Read Only : a podcast where we explore books, share short reviews, and discover how their ideas can transform our everyday lives. From literature and philosophy to spirituality and self-growth, each episode brings you meaningful insights and practical lessons you can apply to the way you think, work, love, and live.
Because reading a book is just the beginning; living its wisdom is where the real journey begins.
🎙️ Hosted by Sayli Shah | Read. Reflect. Apply.

title: Cancer Beyond the Treatment Plan
author: Heidi Dahlenburg, M.AdvNursPrac, Adv. Dip. Applied Science (Naturopathy)
description: Cancer Beyond the Treatment Plan explores the evolving field of integrative cancer care, examining emerging therapies, complementary approaches, and the research informing their potential role alongside conventional cancer treatment. Hosted by Heidi, a clinical nurse and naturopathic clinician with a Master’s degree in Advanced Nursing Practice, the podcast takes a critical, evidence-informed look at the possibilities, limitations, and unanswered questions in integrative oncology.

title: The Strong Dogs Podcast
author: Steven Jankovic
description:
The Strong Dogs Podcast explores dogs, discipline, personal growth, and the lessons that connect them.
Through dog training, life experiences, business, relationships, travel, and philosophy, Steven shares ideas and conversations designed to help people build stronger relationships with their dogs and become stronger versions of themselves.
Because strong dogs don't happen by accident—and neither do strong humans.

title: Công Ty Giúp Việc Chuyên Nghiệp 3Clean
author: 3Clean
description:
Là một trong những công ty giúp việc uy tín và lâu năm, công ty giúp việc 3Clean đã khẳng định vị thế hàng đầu của mình trong ngành giúp việc nhà. Với sự đa dạng về các dịch vụ, đã giúp cho 3Clean tiếp cận được một lượng lớn khách hàng có nhu cầu về dịch vụ giúp việc, đáp ứng các nhu cầu khắt khe và đa dạng mà khách hàng đưa ra.

Xây dựng một doanh nghiệp vững mạnh có thể cạnh tranh và phát triển cùng với các doanh nghiệp khác trên thế giới.

title: Right Where She Was 🌹
author: Nia Pitts
description:
Somewhere between who she was and who she's becoming, every woman has a story.
Right Where She Was is a podcast about marriage, motherhood, identity, and the seasons that shape us. Through honest conversations and personal reflections, we explore what it means to grow, evolve, and hold on to yourself through it all.

title: TRUE STORY by Explore English
author: Explore English
description: TRUE STORY is an English-learning podcast from Explore English that brings real stories to life through natural, engaging storytelling. Each episode helps English learners strengthen their listening comprehension, vocabulary, pronunciation, and understanding of natural spoken English—all while enjoying a story worth hearing.

title: Your English Story
author: Stephanie Kable
description: Your English Story is a podcast about how English shapes people's careers and lives. Host Stephanie Kable, who runs the online school Live English, talks with professionals who went from nervous beginners to working and presenting in English. Each episode follows a journey: where they started, what was hardest, and the habits that finally worked. If you've ever felt fluency was for other people, this is for you. Every episode ends with the guest's top tip and a book or resource that helped. New voices, new stories.

title: Girls Talk With Tolu
author: (GTWT)
description:
This podcast is for 
- the woman who feels unseen but keeps showing up.
- the woman who is growing but still figuring things out.
- the woman balancing faith, family, purpose and pressure. 
- the woman who smiles on the outside but has questions on the inside.
If that's you, then you are in the right place.
This is a safe space.

title: POUR IT OUT WITH LUCHE
author: Pour It Out With Luche
description:
Real life. Real growth. Real girl talk. 🥂💕
Where nothing is off the table—motherhood, relationships, friendships, faith, careers, money, confidence, fitness, healing, personal growth, and everything in between.
Grab your coffee, wine, mocktail—or whatever you’re pouring—and come sit with me. We’re talking personal stories, honest conversations, unpopular opinions, advice, anonymous confessions, and the things we normally only talk about with our girls.

title: Orange and Browned Out
author: brownedoutpod
description: Instant reactions on game days from long-suffering Browns fans

title: Pages of Me
author: Lili Rose
description: Welcome to Pages of Me, a personal journal podcast about everyday experiences, honest thoughts, changing emotions, and the lessons we discover along the way. Life is made up of little moments that often pass without notice, yet some of them leave a lasting mark on who we become. Through personal reflections, meaningful memories, unexpected challenges, and thoughts about growing as a person, this podcast creates space to pause and look at life from a different perspective. Each episode explores the experiences that shape us, the questions we carry, and the small steps that help us move forward. Whether you are reflecting on your own journey or simply looking for a thoughtful voice to accompany your day, Pages of Me invites you to slow down, listen, and remember that every chapter of life has something worth learning from.

title: Open Interest
author: Open Interest
description: Open Interest is a show of conversations with founders and funds in AI and crypto, the people taking the risk and the people pricing it. Recorded live at conferences around the world, before the story settles.

title: Moon Mind Temple (MC)
author: Develop yourself
description: Moon Mind Temple

author: Matthew
description: Where rumors turn into headlines. Trade buzz, game analysis & the hottest takes in sports. 🚨 #InsiderAccess #SportsInsiders

title: The Beacon Jar Podcast
author: Doryen Chin
description: The Beacon Jar is a supernatural horror anthology podcast written and produced by Doryen Chin. Each episode contains a brand-new thrilling short story written specifically for the show, presented with minimal sound design and thoughtfully chosen music.

title: Prayers and Punchlines
author: Melissa and Kirsten
description:
We’re two lifelong best friends, miles apart but always in each other’s business. Between raising families, keeping our faith, maintaining friendships, and trying to keep our sanity—we’ve got plenty to talk about!
So grab your coffee, say a quick prayer, and get ready to laugh with us as we navigate life together, one prayer and one punchline at a time.
This is Prayers and Punchlines!

title: Think - Lead - Repeat
author: London Porter
description:
In 3 minutes or less - each episode sharpens your thinking, builds your leadership edge, and elevates how you show up at work and in life.
No fluff - No endless interviews - Just practical insights, actionable ideas, and a daily mindset reset that helps you think smarter, lead better, and repeat the habits that move careers forward.
One skill - One episode - One better version of yourself. Lock in. Let's go!
Based on the book Think – Lead – Repeat – By London Porter (Available on Amazon Books)

title: Global Health Research
author: Brooks
description:
Global‍‍‍ Health Research www.globalhealthresearch.net looks into and discusses public health, medicine, science, and development at a global level through interviews with professionals.

Each episode will delve into one or more of the global factors that affect public health in various parts of the world such as infectious diseases, ways of developing scientific careers, and changes in healthcare laws, and the show will be a forum on these very important issues with knowledgeable views on each side as supported by research.

On this show, you will get to listen to how guests overcome the problems, share their research results and suggest ways of solving those major health issues affecting the planet right ‍‍‍now.

title: 2 Bros 2 Brews 1 Movie Podcast
author: 2B2B1Movie
description:
🎬☕ 2 Bros 2 Brews Movie Podcast
Two bros, two brews, and a whole lot of movies! 🎥🍻 Join us as we talk about our favorite films, share honest reviews, debate the best and worst moments, and have plenty of laughs along the way. Whether it’s a blockbuster, a classic, or a hidden gem, we’re here to break it all down—one brew at a time!
🎙️ Grab a brew, press play, and join the conversation!

title: Untold Worlds
author: Calvin
description: Untold Worlds, a documentary podcast exploring the remarkable places, fascinating cultures, and real stories that make our world extraordinary. From forgotten historical sites and remote communities to unusual traditions and places rarely discussed, each episode takes you beyond the familiar to discover something new. Through engaging storytelling and thoughtful exploration, we uncover the people, events, and discoveries that help us understand our planet from different perspectives. Whether you enjoy history, geography, cultural heritage, or the hidden stories behind everyday life, Untold Worlds invites you to look closer, question what you know, and discover the world one story at a time.

title: The Explainer
author: The Explainer
description: The Explainer is an educational channel that explores human history, behavior, and the science behind everyday things we take for granted.

title: The Hospitality Connection
author: Scott Samuels and Alex Gould
description: Every great hospitality business is built on people. On The Hospitality Connection, Scott Samuels, CEO of Horizon Hospitality, and Alex Gould, Director of Strategic Partnerships, sit down with the executives, operators, and HR leaders who know how to find great people, grow them, and keep them. Candid conversations on hiring, retention, leadership, culture, operations, and growth, with ideas you can put to work right away. Because taking care of people is what hospitality does best.

title: Rehearsing Tomorrow
author: Julia Pahina and Brough Johnson🎙️
description: Noticing what’s changing. Rehearsing what comes next.

title: Biscuits & SEC
author: Biscuits and SEC
description:
Biscuits & SEC is the show for SEC football fans who want the latest SEC news, college football news, game predictions, recruiting, rankings, trasnfer portal updates, coaches, players, rivalries, game analysis and more. 
From Alabama, Georgia, LSU, Tennessee, Florida, Auburn, Ole Miss, Texas, Texas A&M, Oklahoma, Missouri, South Carolina, Kentucky, Arkansas, Mississippi State, Vanderbilt and MORE, we break down the biggest stories in the Southeastern Conference. 
Saturdays in the south are the best. We've got you smothered and covered.

title: Sound Opinions
author: Makie
description: Welcome to Sound Opinions, the podcast where music sparks conversation and every listener has a point of view. From chart-topping hits and newly released albums to legendary artists and changing music trends, we take a closer look at the sounds everyone is talking about. Each episode brings honest commentary, thoughtful reviews, interesting comparisons, and fresh perspectives on the music industry. Why does one song become a worldwide hit while another goes unnoticed? What makes an album memorable, and how do artists influence the way music evolves? We explore these questions while celebrating different tastes and encouraging listeners to think beyond the headlines. Whether you love pop, rock, hip-hop, R&B, or other genres, join us for lively music discussions where opinions are welcome and the conversation never stops. This is Sound Opinions—real music, honest reviews, and different perspectives.

title: Calvary Bible Church - Grass Valley
author: Calvary Bible Church
description: Weekly sermons and Wednesday night studies

title: The Anchor Angle
author: Ray Mathoda
description:
Hosted by Ray Mathoda, CEO of Anchor Loans, The Anchor Angle delivers real-world insight on the U.S. housing market, construction trends, and real estate investing — from someone who’s shaping the future of it.

Each episode dives into what’s really happening behind the headlines: shifts in homebuilding, investment strategies that work in any market, and how private lending and smart capital are driving new housing supply across America.

Ray brings decades of experience and a unique perspective as both an industry innovator and a purpose-driven leader. Whether you’re a builder, investor, or simply curious about where housing is headed next, The Anchor Angle gives you the clarity, data, and perspective you won’t find anywhere else.

Tune in for honest conversations, expert takes, and grounded optimism about the future of housing.

title: The Technology Economy
author: Jason Marks | LEAD Above
description:
Technology. Business. Everything Connected.

Join technology consultant and sales educator Jason Marks and his AI cohost Claire for practical, in-depth conversations about the technology shaping business—and the business behind technology. From AI and cloud infrastructure to Microsoft licensing, cybersecurity, and how technology gets bought and sold, each episode connects the details to decisions you can actually use.

Built for technology professionals, sales teams, business leaders, and curious people who want to understand how it all fits together. Focused topics, real-world perspectives, and room to go deeper. New episodes when there is a conversation worth having.

A LEAD Above production.

title: Nia After Dark
author: Nia Rossi
description:
Welcome to Nia After Dark, your cozy corner of the horror universe! 

Join me for horror movie reviews, TV recaps, deep dives, and recommendations covering everything from haunted houses and supernatural terrors to slashers, creatures, and the performances that deserve more love. Whether we're revisiting horror classics, exploring new releases, or defending an underrated favorite, there's always something lurking around the corner.

If you love a good scare and can't resist a story that keeps you thinking long after the credits roll, you've found your place.

Grab your favorite drink, settle in, and let's talk horror!

title: The Bigger Map
author: With Aim
description: A weekly conversation for professionals, founders and couples weighing a move abroad or a second base. Each episode follows one decision, such as where to live, how to move legally, or what daily life costs, and works through the evidence, the tradeoffs and who it suits. Researched from official sources, candid about the downsides, and never a city ranking. Companion to The Bigger Map newsletter.

title: MY STUDIES AND MY FUTURE
author: Andrea martinez
description: In this podcast, I talk about my studies, my future plans, and the importance of leadership, responsibility, and teamwork. I also share how learning and hard work can help me achieve my goals.

title: Down Low
author: Heart Out Media
description:
Welcome to Down Low, a podcast where we chat about poos, wees and all the stuff we’ve been taught to feel squeamish about. We’re here to talk about living a full life with continence challenges – from relationships and sex to work, ambition and play. And we’re not at all ashamed to get into the messy details of it all.

Join host Anja Christoffersen as she interviews guests who, like the advocate and In Crowd magazine editor herself, are managing catheters, ostomies, pads and a multitude of complex medical conditions.

Together, we’ll make our way from the darkest of times to the moments that set us free. We’ll share hard-won advice and tips for those who are new to the club. And we’ll celebrate what becomes possible when we’re no longer ashamed to tell our stories.

Let’s get down to it on Down Low.

title: DeadHeading
author: Jolene Skvarek
description:
Put the kettle on and take a turn round the garden with Cora and August, your hosts for a very genteel sort of murder.
Each week, over a good cup of tea, we tell the story of a cosy little killing — a poisoning in the potting shed, a fatal supper, a grievance settled quietly among the roses. Plus seasonal gardening tips (mind the foxglove) and the correct cup for any occasion (milk in first, for a funeral).
Cosy true crime for anyone who's looked at a lovely garden and wondered what's buried under it. Wear your gloves. Do come back and see us.

title: Davey & Annie Hall See It All
author: Davey & Annie Hall See It All
description:
Love. Travel. Points. And 30 years of adventures together.
Join Davey and Annie Hall as we share three decades of traveling the world, making memories, and discovering how points and miles can make extraordinary adventures affordable.
From romantic getaways and family trips to disagreements about travel rewards, expect practical tips, great stories, and plenty of laughs.
Whether you're new to points and miles or an experienced traveler, we'll help you travel smarter, spend less, and see more of the world.
Because the best adventures are about who you share them with.

title: Sounds of Shizen: Listening to Japan’s National Parks
author: Export Japan Inc.
description: Dive into an acoustic journey of Japan’s national parks! Sounds of Shizen takes you across the country’s most breathtaking landscapes, where every episode begins with a clip from a field recording. Unlike national parks in other parts of the world, Japan’s park system is unique in that it integrates local human activity and culture, resulting in an extraordinary heritage. Alongside guides and park insiders who share travel tips and first-hand knowledge, we take a closer look at these spaces and unpack their legacy. Join us as we travel the archipelago and prepare you for your own journey!

title: Aged Care Conversations by Harbourside
author: Harbourside Port Stephens
description:
Aged care can feel confusing, whether you're starting to look for yourself or helping someone you love.
Aged Care Conversations by Harbourside is here to make it easier. In each episode, host Kylie Jacques sits down with the people who know aged care best: the staff who provide care every day, and the residents and families who have lived it.
Together they talk plainly about the questions people really ask. How does support at home work? What is retirement living actually like? How do you choose a provider? And how do you look after yourself when you're the one caring?
Harbourside Port Stephens is a local Australian, not-for-profit aged care provider in Port Stephens, NSW. We offer home care, retirement living and residential care.
Find out more at harboursideportstephens.com.au

title: Cafecito with SVL
author: Silicon Valley Latino

title: Women in the Shadows by Ann Bannon.
author: Popular Culture and Religion.
description:
Women in the Shadows by Ann Bannon.  
Women in the Shadows is a lesbian pulp fiction novel written in 1959 by Ann Bannon (pseudonym of Ann Weldy). It is the third in a series of pulp fiction novels that eventually came to be known as The Beebo Brinker Chronicles. It was originally published in 1959 by Gold Medal Books, again in 1983 by Naiad Press, and again in 2002 by Cleis Press. Each edition was adorned with a different cover. This book proved to be Bannon's most controversial and unpopular of the series, blurring lines between heroes and villains, especially on the tail of the triumphant and groundbreaking end of I Am a Woman. Bannon stated that the subject matter paralleled Bannon's own frustrations in her marriage. The content also focused on then-whispered of topics such as interracial relationships, domestic violence, and self-loathing in matters of race and sexuality. As Bannon explained in the 2001 edition forward of the first book in the series, Odd Girl Out, Gold Medal Books publishers had control over the cover art and the title. Bannon's publisher titled the book. Lesbian pulp fiction books usually showed suggestive art with obscure titles that hinted at what the subject matter was inside.

Neither is trying to win.

Every episode closes on The Takeaway. A day or two after the argument, each of them records alone and blind, five to ten minutes, with his own recommended course of action. Not a joint conclusion, not a split-the-difference compromise. You get to watch where an honest argument actually leads two people who heard exactly the same thing.


No running tally of who was right. Markets hand everybody a hot streak, usually just before the luck turns. You are here to think alongside two people who end up in different places.

description:
Nothing Stands Alone (Ontological Poverty)
Existence, Dependence, and the Illusion of Self-Sufficiency
What does it mean to exist if nothing exists by itself?
In Season Two of Theophanergia, we explore the idea of ontological poverty: the condition of beings whose existence is not self-generated, self-sustaining, or absolutely possessed. This is not poverty in the economic or psychological sense, but a deeper metaphysical dependence at the very structure of being.
Drawing on the language of theoretical mysticism and philosophical metaphysics, the season examines the difference between external lack and existential dependence, and follows this distinction through questions of selfhood, knowledge, power, possession, prayer, love, suffering, responsibility, and freedom.
Across the season, we ask what changes when existence is understood as received rather than owned; when strength no longer means self-sufficiency; when knowledge is true without being total; and when responsibility remains real even within radical dependence.
Nothing Stands Alone is an inquiry into the illusion of absolute independence and the possibility of a different way of inhabiting existence—one grounded in relation, receptivity, humility, and presence.

title: The Unseen Truth: In the Age of AI
author: Recovery
description:
What if the video you watched never happened? What if the voice of someone you love was generated by a machine? And what if a photograph that seemed to prove everything was nothing more than a collection of artificial pixels?

Welcome to The Unseen Truth, a thought-provoking podcast exploring one of the most disturbing questions of our technological age: can we still trust our own eyes?

Artificial intelligence is transforming the way we create and experience digital content. Images can be generated from simple descriptions, voices can be imitated, and realistic videos can depict people doing things they have never done. As these technologies become more sophisticated, the boundary between reality and fabrication grows increasingly difficult to recognize.

Across two compelling episodes, we explore how AI-generated deception works, why the human brain is vulnerable to convincing visual evidence, and how misinformation can influence our beliefs, relationships, and decisions.

But this series goes beyond technology. It examines the psychological consequences of living in a world where seeing is no longer the same as knowing. When almost anything can be fabricated, how do we decide what deserves our trust?

Because the greatest danger may not be that we believe every lie, but that we eventually stop believing the truth.

title: Unhinged: One Star Reviews
author: Adrie Lopez Mackay
description:
This is Unhinged where we discuss one star reviews of famous places, landmarks and destinations around the world. 


My name's Adrie and as an expat living in Vietnam like everyone else, I love travelling. But a business or landmark is never far away from the dreaded one star review.


We're going to read our reviews, then guess the place first and then decide if the reviewer is truly unhinged, semi hinged, or hinged.


Unhinged means a mentally unbalanced, deranged, or behaving in an extremely irrational and out of control manner. We've all read an unhinged one star review.

title: The Hypercube Energy Podcast
author: Hypercube
description:
The Hypercube Energy Podcast explores the application of technology, data and AI across the energy sector.

In the fast-moving energy landscape, organisations of all sizes need to understand and adopt emerging tech to tackle complex problems, identify new areas of innovation and capitalise on opportunity.

What should an energy technology strategy look like?

How do we identify what problems to solve first?

What innovations are being made in the industry?

These are the questions that host Adam Sroka seeks to answer on this show.

In each episode, he sits down with tech experts and business leaders from the energy sector to understand exactly how they are solving energy-specific data challenges today.

You can learn more about Hypercube - Energy Technology Partner at wearehypercube.com

Join the Beyond Energy Community: wearehypercube.com/join-the-community/

title: True crime podcast
author: SC17 SC17
description:
True Crime Podcast

Explore real criminal cases, unsolved mysteries, shocking investigations, and extraordinary stories from around the world. Discover the facts behind the headlines, uncover hidden details, and examine the evidence in compelling narratives that reveal the complex realities of crime and justice.

Real Cases. Hidden Truths. Unanswered Questions.

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/true-crime-podcast--7478953/support.

title: The Field
author: dtcvsu@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Field tells the true stories behind the greatest discoveries in physics. Each episode, host Nirob takes one phenomenon, one experiment, or one theory — Galileo's falling bodies, Newton's gravity, the double-slit experiment, Einstein's E=mc², the search for the Higgs boson — and rebuilds it: the physicists who chased it, the experiment that tested it, the moment of breakthrough, and the world it made.

From the atom to the expanding universe, from radioactivity to relativity, from the uncertainty principle to the first image of a black hole, The Field is about the relentless human effort to understand the universe — how ideas are tested, how theories are overturned, and why the laws of physics are among the greatest achievements of the human mind. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is still debated. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

title: If Bibles Could Talk
author: If Bible Could Talk
description:
This isn't just about reading the Bible. It's about understanding it, reflecting on it, and applying its wisdom to real life.

 Ads and Sponsorship - onpointstudio45@gmail.com

If Bibles Could Talk = Ancient stories. Timeless Wisdom. A better way to live.

title: METAtation
author: Beolty
description:
This podcast captures a specific tradition of meditation with an incredible depth to it. It was made for and exercised by the ruling class. In more modern terms, it's a meditation for leaders, the affluent, the privileged.


I call it a meditation for the elite as it cascades down from them.


Most forms of meditation seek to give the everyday person balance in the present moment. The meditation for the elite seeks to enable them to choreograph the results of meditation exercised by the people within their influence. Much like governments seek to choreograph their nations.


Through this podcast, we're looking past the points of view of meditation and are returning it to factory settings. From this central position, we'll push open both gates with a thrust to liberate meditation's full potential and enable it to become…as effortless as breathing.

Welcome to METAtation.

title: Economy & Finance

Welcome to Global Economy & Finance, your source for insights into the world of money, business, and economic change.

Explore global economic trends, financial markets, personal finance, investing, entrepreneurship, inflation, wealth creation, and the forces shaping the world economy. Through clear explanations and engaging storytelling, we break down complex financial topics to help you understand how money works and how economic decisions affect everyday life.

title: GREAT ABYSS
author: GREAT ABYSS
description:
Welcome to The Great Abyss, your atmospheric archive dedicated to unearthing the profoundest mysteries of the universe and the hidden chapters of human history.
​If you find yourself captivated by the vast, enigmatic void of space, the secrets of deep time, and the artifacts that hint at forbidden knowledge, you have arrived at your new intellectual sanctuary. This channel is for the curious, the dreamers, and those who seek to understand the unknowable.
​In a setting like a forgotten, gaslit study filled with esoteric tomes and complex contraptions, we don't just recount tales; we conduct forensic examinations. Each episode is a careful decryption of a cosmic signal, an analysis of a high-profile historical enigma, or an exploration of inexplicable phenomena. We delve into theories on black holes and the nature of dark matter, decipher ancient, forgotten texts, investigate inexplicable disappearances, and explore the tantalizing hints of lost advanced knowledge.

title: The Blueprint
author: aqymmw@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Blueprint tells the true stories behind the world's greatest structures. Each episode, host Nirob takes one building, one bridge, or one feat of engineering — the Great Pyramid, the dome of the Pantheon, the Eiffel Tower, the Brooklyn Bridge, the Panama Canal, the Burj Khalifa — and rebuilds it: the architects and engineers who designed it, the labour and invention that raised it, the disasters and doubts it survived, and the world it shaped.

From the arenas of Rome to the cathedrals of the Middle Ages, from the skyscraper race to the unfinished cathedral of Gaudí, from dams that tamed rivers to towers that pierce the sky, The Blueprint is about the astonishing human will to build — how structures are designed, how they stand, and why they say more about a civilisation than any document. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

Grow into your best self.

title: Grant Harting: Medication Pricing & Pharmacy Truths

He founded CrushCost to help people cut prescription costs and now runs one of the fastest-growing pharmacy channels in the country. He tests gas station pills in labs, explains what is actually in supplements, breaks down the most expensive medications in the world, and teaches people how to use melatonin and zinc the right way. His work has made him known as America's Pharmacist. Follow the show and leave a five-star rating if you learn something that saves you money.

title: Better Tomorrow
author: Joe Stone-Lee
description: Life for young people is tough. So many issues such as unemployment, housing, climate change and the cost of living crisis will directly impact young people across the country. Yet no one seems to be solving these issues. On Better Tomorrow, in each episode student Joe Stone-Lee will explore a new topic challenging young people with an expert in the hope to find where it all went wrong for younger generations and how it can be solved to build a Better Tomorrow for young people.

This is where i have all sorts of life conversations with myself: random thoughts, lessons learned, mental health awareness, friendships, love interests and everything in between.

Basically these are notes to myself, from myself to Lee. If you relate then you’re definitely in the right place. If not, well… sucks to be you.💋

The Follow Through: Where Sunday Meets Monday
A podcast from Fission Student Ministries at Rowland Road Baptist Church.
Helping parents bring Sunday to every day. Each Monday, this 10–15 minute podcast connects your teenager’s Sunday night message and small group discussions with practical discipleship at home. Through biblical encouragement, relevant research, and simple conversation starters, we help you ENGAGE your student, EQUIP their faith, and encourage them to EXIST in the world as followers of Jesus.
You don’t need every answer to start a meaningful conversation.

title: Mondays from the Middle
author: Latosha Leonard
description: Mondays from the Middle is a weekly podcast hosted by licensed counselor and transition specialist Latosha D. Leonard, LPC. Each episode is 10–15 minutes built around one idea from the Middle of Change framework — the philosophy that the space between what ended and what hasn't started yet is a real, navigable place.  Every week includes a short teaching, a guided practice you do in the episode, and one honest reflection question to carry into the week. For women navigating life transitions, identity shifts, and the quiet disorientation that doesn't have a name yet.

title: Lore & Disorder
author: Amber | Lore & Disorder
description:
Books, games, fandoms, and whatever fictional character is currently ruining my life. Lore & Disorder is a delightfully chaotic dive into the stories we obsess over—from fantasy and romantasy to thrillers, manga, audiobooks, story-driven games, indie authors, publishing, and everything in between. Expect reviews, ridiculous tangents, behind-the-scenes adventures, occasional guests, and absolutely no guarantee that I’ll stay on topic.

author: David Longenecker
description:
The Gospel isn't the story of a world God gives up on. It's the story of Jesus Christ, who has already won.
Explore the Bible's biggest questions about salvation, hell, the cross, Revelation, and our future with author and Bible teacher David E. Longenecker.
Our four Gospel pillars:
• UNDIVIDED — The Father is exactly like Jesus.
• HEALING — He destroys corruption, not creation.
• UNITED — Jesus entered our death and rose as our life.
• VICTORIOUS — He has conquered and is making all things new.
Honest questions. An open Bible. A Savior who has already won.

title: Finding the Merit
author: Colin Das
description:
We focus on finding the merits of what is out there. Instead of focusing on the negatives, we find the good stuff and expose and discuss that. We dive into wide ranging sources from happiness to love. 
The hosts, Colin and Fedor, are engineers and breakdancers, so they often seek to extract the mental models, make connections to dancing, and talk about video games.

title: Silent Key
author: ARC Productions
description:
There are things people on Cedar Key don’t talk about. Lena Allan’s father recorded them.


After his mysterious death, Lena returns to the remote island. She finds a shack full of taped broadcasts. Years of strange transmissions her father collected for reasons she has yet to understand.


Each tape gives her another piece of the father she barely knew, and another reason to question the people who knew him best.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Oxford Writing Career Guide
author: Oxford Writers' House
description:
What’s it like to dig into the stories behind gambling circuits or government corruption? How do authors come up with fresh ideas for gripping novels? What pushes a literary agent’s “yes” button? 


Join Oxford University student Nancy Gittus as she speaks to renowned investigative journalists, award-winning novelists, celebrated academics, and successful publishers uncovering the diverse array of paths a passion for words offers. 


A way with words opens doors. Follow Nancy to get a behind-the-scenes view of the writing life!

title: Could It Though?
author: Garry "Gazza"
description:
Could Elon Musk end world poverty? Could AI run a country? Could you buy every lottery ticket and guarantee a win? Big “what if” questions, answered with real numbers.

Each episode takes one wild hypothetical and runs it through three questions. Could it? Is it even possible? Would it? What happens when someone actually tries? Should it? And if we could, is it a good idea?

Hosted by Gazza. Real maths, real sources, short episodes and a straight verdict at the end. From stopping ageing to moving a million people to Mars, we take the questions everyone wonders about and find out whether they’d actually work.

New questions, real answers. Could it? Would it? Should it?

The Whole Story is a living archive of women building things before we know how their stories end.
Businesses, creative projects, community initiatives, side hustles, new chapters — we record women in the middle of making them, while the decisions are still decisions and not yet lessons and we follow-up with them to see how those decisions turned out later!
These aren't success stories. They're records of uncertainty, experimentation, pivots, pauses, ordinary days and everything else that usually gets edited out.
The Whole Story is a record of women in the act of becoming.

Every business has a story worth telling.

title: The Black Death: London in the Shadow
author: Latif Kumhar
description:
The Black Death: London in the Shadow of Death is a three-episode historical podcast exploring one of the darkest chapters in London’s history.

In the middle of the fourteenth century, an invisible enemy entered England and eventually reached London. What followed was a catastrophe unlike anything the city had experienced before. Families were separated, streets became strangely quiet, churches struggled to cope with the dead, and burial grounds filled faster than anyone could have imagined.

The series begins with the arrival of the plague in London in 1348 and explores how medieval Londoners reacted to a disease they could neither understand nor effectively treat. The second episode takes listeners into the heart of the disaster, examining the symptoms, fear, mass deaths, emergency cemeteries, and desperate attempts to find explanations and cures.

The final episode moves beyond the immediate horror to explore what happened after the worst had passed. The Black Death did not simply kill people. It changed wages, labour, social relationships, religion, and the balance of power within medieval society.

This is not only a story about death. It is also a story about fear, survival, resilience, and a city permanently changed by an invisible enemy.

This isn’t about quick fixes or perfect schedules. The guiding idea here is understanding before fixing: figuring out what’s actually happening with your baby and your family before you change anything, so you can build routines that are steady, flexible, and sustainable.

Through solo episodes and conversations with trusted experts, Doula Talk helps you make sense of sleep struggles, feeding questions, recovery, and decision overload, without shame, pressure, or panic.

The podcast is currently on a break, but more than 60 episodes are waiting for you. You don’t need to listen in order. Find the season you’re in and start there. Every episode has a matching blog post, and a guide to the full archive, organized by topic, is on the blog at douladeb.com/blog.

Hosted by Dr. Donald with presenter Mark

In this in-depth episode, Dr. Donald and Mark explore one of the most critical topics in modern medicine: organ failure. From sudden multi-organ collapse in the intensive care unit to the slow progression of chronic disease, they break down what organ failure really means, how it develops, and what can be done about it.

Listeners will learn:
- The difference between acute and chronic organ failure
- How the kidneys, liver, heart and lungs fail — causes, warning signs and treatments
- Why multiple organ dysfunction syndrome (MODS) is so dangerous
- Practical management strategies used in intensive care
- Proven ways to reduce personal risk
- Emerging therapies and research offering new hope
- Guidance for families navigating critical illness

Clear, compassionate and evidence-based, this episode gives patients, caregivers and health professionals a thorough understanding of a complex subject that affects millions worldwide.
